text:
deploybot: preflight-check 2026-03-21T12:13Z - HOLD: release blocked for prod promotion. CONFIGMAP 'model-service-config' key mismatch between staging and prod. See failure: expected env var MODEL_ENDPOINT present in prod, found modelEndpoint instead.

rachel: tagging @owen @priya - this looks like a casing/normalization issue from the config generator.

owen: ugh. i remember we changed the template generator to preserve original key casing. does staging have MODEL_ENDPOINT or modelEndpoint?

priya: staging (working) has MODEL_ENDPOINT=grpc://models-svc.default.svc:9000
prod (bad): modelEndpoint=grpc://models-svc.default.svc:9000

dan: inference runtime reads MODEL_ENDPOINT only (env var lookup is case-sensitive). so prod falling back to default local socket -> degraded routing. saw increased latency in probed requests.

rachel: how did this get applied? PR 5582 updated the config templater and was merged by @priya yesterday. @priya can you confirm the template output?

priya: confirmed: template change preserved original field names from upstream YAML which introduced camelCase on that key. i can generate corrected config and open INFRA-1301 to track. sorry about that.

release-coordinator: decision needed: quick patch to prod configmap + restart pods within morning change window (ends in 30m) OR hold and roll back to pinned image which maintains compat with camelCase for 24h. what's risk?

owen: quick patch safe. steps:
1) kubectl -n prod get configmap model-service-config -o yaml > /tmp/cm.yaml
2) edit data to replace modelEndpoint -> MODEL_ENDPOINT (keep value identical, base64 if present)
3) kubectl apply -f /tmp/cm.yaml && kubectl rollout restart deploy/model-service -n prod
4) run smoke: 10 /v1/generate calls, compare latency and routing headers
If patch can't be done within 10m (IAM token refresh issue), fallback = revert image to v2026.03.19-7b1cde (pinned).

infra-bot: note: CI runner cannot edit prod configmaps without elevated token; @dan do you want me to queue a privileged patch job?

dan: yes please. queue with short TTL and record audit log. also capture current configmap to S3 with key infra-audit/3141599999-prepatch.yaml.gz.

rachel: smoke criteria: routes hit models-svc (header x-routing-version: new) and p95 latency < 300ms for 2m, no 5xx. Also check model selection correctness for 100 sample prompts (quick eval).

priya: i'll prepare PR INFRA-1301 with corrected template and a one-line note in release notes: "Config generator template updated; patch applied to prod to normalize env var name MODEL_ENDPOINT".

deploybot: [action] hold set by rachel until 3141600899 (15m).

owen: i'll run the pod restart and smoke once infra-bot posts the privileged job. posting job id infra-job-7742 now.

infra-bot: infra-job-7742 applied patch to configmap and restarted deployment. prepatch saved to s3://redwood-infra-audit/3141599999-prepatch.yaml.gz.

priya: verifying smoke tests now. results: 10/10 routes to models-svc, p95=220ms, 0 5xx in 2m. quick eval: 98/100 prompt checks match expected model outputs (two differences under threshold).

rachel: good. decision: unblock promotion and continue rollout. release-coordinator please add release note: "Prod config normalized for MODEL_ENDPOINT; minor canary deviations observed and monitored."

release-coordinator: release notes updated and change window annotation added. resuming promotion. thanks team :shipit:

dan: will run a follow-up job to rotate the elevated token and close the infra-job audit.

priya: opening INFRA-1301 and linking this thread. also adding a CI lint to reject generator outputs containing camelCase for known env vars.

deploybot: [info] promotion resumed at 3141600299 - thread closed.
